messages:
Lina: Quick monthly check-in on recurring incident patterns. I extracted top recurring buckets for Feb-Mar. Short list: canary config drift, cache tombstones, retry storms to auth, memory pressure on quantized models. Who can own remediation items?

Owen: I can own canary config drift. Plan: add preflight lint + a CI gate that compares rollout config vs router mapping. ETA: 2026-03-26.

Ravi: I'll take cache tombstones. Suspect restart ordering + stale tombstone propagation. Will open a focused postmortem and propose a cleanup job. Investigation doc by 2026-03-18.

Denise: for retry storms -> short-term backoff+jitter and a token-bucket on outbound auth calls. Long-term: shared token cache. I can do short-term fix by 2026-03-15.

Lina: adding actions to the incident tracker: "Canary config preflight" | Owner: Owen | Due: 2026-03-26; "Cache tombstone postmortem" | Owner: Ravi | Due: 2026-03-18; "Auth retry mitigation" | Owner: Denise | Due: 2026-03-15.

Owen: also recommend a dashboard widget with weekly trend for top-6 causes. If we surface it in #incidents as a weekly bot post, teams won't be surprised.

SRE Bot: Tip: add severity and customer-impact flags to tracker entries. Use format: "Title | Owner | Due | Severity | Notes".

Ravi: noted. Marking cache tombstones as high severity for two tenants.

Denise: question: any preference for who coordinates customer notifications if it's tenant-impacting?

Lina: CS should be pinged automatically via the tracker tag "requires-customer-notify". I'll enable that.

Owen: can we get a 30-min sync next week to align infra deps? I'll need infra for the preflight hook.

Lina: scheduling: 2026-03-16 11:00 PT. Invite sent.

SRE Bot: Reminder set: "Recurring incident follow-up sync" on 2026-03-16 11:00.
